defs.def: when you digest food, or it digests, it is changed into substances that your body can use 消化

ex.s: Within weeks, it had all been digested, and all that was left was pure water.
ex.t: 几周内，污泥全被消化了，剩下的只有纯净水。

ex.s: digest the meal easilyB. manage without breakfast
ex.t: 这些结果的启示是，要从运动中获得最大的健康益处，不吃东西可能是明智的选择。

ex.s: It was a picture of a boa constrictor digesting an elephant.
ex.t: 那是一条正在消化大象的蟒蛇的画。

ex.s: This affects the crops grown on the land and, in turn, the animals and humans who digest them.
ex.t: 这影响了土地上种植的作物，进而影响了消化这些作物的人和动物。

ex.s: Eating slowly also allows your body to digest your food better, and will allow you to enjoy your food more.
ex.t: 慢慢吃饭也能让你的身体更好地消化食物，并使你更享受食物。

ex.s: As (4) like cakes are digested, blood sugar levels can go up quickly.
ex.t: 当像蛋糕这样的食物被消化时，血糖水平会迅速上升。

defs.def: to think about sth so that you fully understand it 领会；领悟；理解

ex.s: That’s why this issue (期) of Writer’s Digest aims to help you figure out how to write the best ending for whatever kind of writing you’re doing.
ex.t: 所以本期《作家文摘》旨在帮助你弄清楚如何为你正在写的任何类型的作品写出最好的结局。
